verdict.rationale: Lever's Advanced Nurture page says it automates personalized outreach at scale and lets recruiters reconnect with previous candidates and follow up automatically. That covers the nurture and automated-outreach core of the story, and Automation Hub emailing adds some support. However, the evidence is thin marketing copy and never shows prospect pools, multi-step sequences with open or click tracking, or campaigns aimed at future roles. Missing for 10: prospect pools or talent-pool management, email sequence tracking and analytics, explicit nurture campaigns for future roles, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
